stories.title: Tiny Scottish Island's Little Historical Society Makes Massive Discovery
stories.label: science
stories.summary: A small volunteer historical society on a tiny Scottish island just made a huge discovery. Their digging turned up evidence that the island was actually one of the earliest centers of Christian evangelism anywhere in the British Isles. It's a wonderful reminder that you don't need a big university or a big budget to uncover something historically important. This little island community has now earned a real place on the map of history, all thanks to curious locals who kept asking questions.
stories.why_good: A real archaeological discovery made by ordinary community volunteers, with no suffering or conflict involved.

stories.title: NGO Celebrates 70 Million Amazon Acres Conserved After Protecting Area Called a 'Link of Life'
stories.label: earth
stories.summary: A conservation group called the Rainforest Trust just helped create a massive new 715,000-acre wildlife reserve in Bolivia, along a river so rich with life that scientists call it a 'link of life.' This new reserve pushes the group's total protected land across the Amazon region past 70 million acres. That's an enormous swath of rainforest now safeguarded for the plants, animals, and indigenous communities who depend on it. It's a milestone built one real, completed project at a time, not just a promise for later.
stories.why_good: A concrete, already-finished land protection milestone that safeguards a huge, biodiverse region of the Amazon—genuinely good for the planet, fully happened, and free of political conflict.
